summary: The divergent StopSign placement is currently inferred rather than read: nodes 1, 2 and 5 hold the marker at index 37 while node 3 holds it at index 36, so index 36 should contain a value on the former group. This revision adds n1_k36, n2_k36 and n5_k36, the entry kind at index 36 on those nodes, alongside their existing accepted, decided and index-37 kinds. A value there against node 3's StopSign would directly confirm that the logs differ at index 36, turning the current inference into an observed disagreement; the same kind on both sides would instead limit the problem to the extra position at 37 on one group. The seeded 900-action schedule, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, 150-round convergence, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, the p4_gap invariant and both declared comparisons are unchanged. This is the last outstanding factual question in the investigation.
